meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪和管理长期目标进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在对话中持续跟踪多个长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Track and manage long-running goals persistently
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to persistently track and manage long-running goals in conversation.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按用户要求创建、查看或完成长期目标:记录目标说明与 token 预算,标记完成前会核对真实产出,不确定就视为未完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设定、继续、审计等长期目标操作,或已有进行中目标时。

say.text: 帮我建一个目标:完成 pi-goal 扩展,token 预算 50000。
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并开始跟踪进度。

say.text: 审计当前目标的完成情况,逐项核对证据。
say.note: Claude 会检查实际状态后再决定是否完成。

say.text: 把当前目标标记为完成。
say.note: 若还有未完成工作,Claude 不会直接标记。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude creates, inspects, or completes long-running goals: it stores the objective and token budget, audits actual evidence before completion, and treats uncertainty as incomplete.
howto.when_en: When the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, etc. a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Create a goal: finish the pi-goal extension, token budget 50000.
say_en.note: Claude creates the goal and starts tracking progress.

say_en.text: Audit the current goal and check evidence item by item.
say_en.note: Claude inspects actual state before deciding whether to complete.

say_en.text: Mark the current goal as complete.
say_en.note: If work remains, Claude will not mark it complete.
